entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: 1979 Islamic Revolution, a transformative movement in Iran (1979–1980). Emerged from Islamic Republic and Iranian students seize the US Embassy — 444-day hostage crisis begins. Catalyzed Iraq invades Iran, beginning the longest conventional war of the 20th century and Saddam Hussein.
